svg.title: DX-TRACE · Deployment architecture
svg.desc: Browser, device and integration routes through Caddy, the API gateway and Core.

g.text: Product and Docs host: static files on VPS | App host: session or device route | Identity host: Keycloak
App credential · request filtering and quota
Warehouse and devices · Quality and recall · Workspace permissions · AppKit and workflows · Timers
SQLite transactions · Version checks · Idempotency · Audit and webhooks
Ubuntu VPS: host Caddy forwards to loopback ports. The API gateway and Core use Docker networks.
Backup and verification: SQLite and warehouse files, identity database and independent audit checkpoints.

svg.text: Optional: Core → Flowable OSS → separate PostgreSQL; verified offline cold telemetry exports.
